messages:
anna (Finance): Heads-up — during billing run we applied a Q3 promotional pricing experiment credit to a batch of customer invoices (mostly trials converted to paid). Looks like ~12k of that amount is prepay-like and should be deferred into revenue schedule. Can we confirm calculation and get journal approval before close?

mike (RevOps): Thanks anna. The promo was the ‘Early Adopter’ 30% off for July. I pulled the billing extract and marked impacted invoices in the sheet: https://redwood.app/sr/close/q3-promo (tab = deferral_calc). Numbers in summary row.

ryan (Accounting): I looked at the sheet, anna — looks like gross promo credit 17,500; after usage adjustments ~12,000 qualifies as deferred (multi-month consumption). Proposed month-end JE below. Please review and sign off.

ryan (Accounting): ```Journal entry (proposed)
Date: 1962345600 (EOM posting)
DR: Sales / Deferred Revenue 12,000
CR: Revenue - Subscription 12,000
Memo: Q3 promo deferral - Early Adopter credits (see workbook)
```

jess (PM): Confirming this was intended to be amortized over 3 months (Jul-Sep). The experiment notes show revenue impact coverage = 3mo. @mike can confirm if any customers got one-off refunds that change the calc.

mike (RevOps): Correct, 3-month amortization. I double-checked refunds — none that affect the cohort.

oscar (Legal): Quick check — any contract amendments needed? If we change recognition timing, do we need customer notifications? My read: no contract change, this is a pricing promotion recorded by us. No customer-facing amendment required.

anna (Finance): Thanks — ok on legal. A couple of follow-ups: (1) Can accounting get an approval thread with sign-off from RevOps and PM? (2) Does FP&A want to reflect the deferral in forecast?

mike (RevOps): sign-off from revops: :thumbsup: we approve the calc and 3mo amortization.

jess (PM): sign-off from product: :white_check_mark: we approve amortization period.

ryan (Accounting): Great — I'll prepare the JE and tag for posting. Anna, please confirm the GL subaccount: should we post to 4102 (Subscription Revenue) or 4110 (Promotional Revenue)?

anna (Finance): Put to 4110 - Promotional Revenue so we can easily filter experiment impact in QBR.

close-bot: Reminder: EOM cutoff in 3 hours. Any JE must be submitted to the close queue before 1962345800.

anna (Finance): OK I'm uploading the signed worksheet and screenshots to the close queue now. Filing note: deferral schedule locked at 12,000 amortized Jul/Aug/Sep = 4,000/mo.

ryan (Accounting): Posting after upload. Posting JE id: JE-2026-09-PROMO-01.

anna (Finance): Thanks everyone — closing the thread for audit trail. If anything changes reopen or ping me directly. :memo:
